create_pipeline_init: create a Pipeline instance to initialize the Google Vertex AI manifold with configured model IDs
build_conversation_history: build conversation history from a list of message dicts into Vertex AI Content objects with multi-part text and image support
run_pipeline_pipe: run the pipe method to generate text or streamed responses from Gemini models using OpenWebUI message format
initialize_vertexai: initialize the Vertex AI SDK with project ID and cloud region on pipeline startup or valve update
configure_safety_settings: configure permissive or custom safety settings for harm categories in Vertex AI content generation
